# Naviamp v2.5.0

Naviamp 2.5.0 adds complete editing support for Navidrome 0.64 smart playlists and strengthens
upgrade compatibility for Navidrome's canonical IDs. It also restores precise waveform seeking and
the intended split-view appearance.

Highlights:

- Create and edit smart playlists using Navidrome 0.64 album fields and refresh intervals.
- Preserve Naviamp library, playback, radio, and profile state when Navidrome adopts canonical IDs.
- Scrub accurately across scaled displays and consecutive tracks with different durations.

## Features

- Smart-playlist rules and sorting now support Navidrome 0.64's album date-added, date-modified,
  duration, song-count, and size fields. Naviamp can also import, preserve, validate, edit, and remove
  each playlist's optional `refreshDelay`. See [issue #57](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/57)
  and [pull request #59](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/59).

## Improvements

- Wide split view now includes a 0–100% browser-pane background opacity control, with the existing
  88% appearance retained as the default. The shared preference persists across restarts and is
  included in settings export, import, and sync. See
  [issue #61](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/61) and
  [pull request #63](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/63).

## Bug fixes

- Complete the follow-up canonical-ID migration required after upgrading a connected server to
  Navidrome 0.64. Favorite-artist activity, playback profiles and sessions, radio history, recent
  streams, and composite artwork identifiers are migrated; derived album snapshots are rebuilt when
  they cannot be rewritten safely. See [issue #56](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/56)
  and [pull request #58](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/58).
- Fix waveform clicks and drags seeking ahead or behind the selected point. Coordinates now remain
  in one local space, and changing tracks replaces the previous track's gesture callback and
  duration. See [issue #60](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/60) and
  [pull request #62](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/62).
- Restore the artwork/background gutter along the right edge of wide split view. See
  [issue #61](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/61) and
  [pull request #63](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/63).
- Keep artist and album metadata visible in editable playlist rows at larger font scales instead of
  clipping the second line. See [issue #54](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/54) and
  [pull request #55](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/55).

## Upgrade notes

Existing v2.x installations can upgrade in place. When connecting to Navidrome 0.64, Naviamp runs
the follow-up canonical-ID migration once automatically. Some derived album data may be rebuilt;
no settings reset or manual migration is required.

## Known issues

The iOS artifact remains an unsigned preview. Windows and macOS packages are not publisher-signed
and may show operating-system warnings.
